controls.basis: Attributed current OSM footprints, walls and all14 individually named gates, separate passage ways. All local height controls use one coarse Molen Terrarium tile as an initial research datum; architectural wall, roof, turret and opening dimensions are original visual estimates from operator photographs. No building-level survey or certified vertical datum. Native +X east/+Z south with heading0; map axis only an authoring basis.

nativeAxes.front: West-facing main front; all map bearings baked into native +X east/+Z south
nativeAxes.longitudinal: Summit long wing runs approximately NNE/SSW; authoring plan axis is not facade approval
nativeAxes.origin: Horizontal exact-QID castle research anchor; modelY0 at first-gate coarse terrain datum, summit research contactY 92.0827

reconstruction.scope: Current complete architectural fortification draft: summit U-shaped castle/open court, slate roofs and turret cones, upper gallery, church and chapel,14 distinct mapped access gates with open passages,watchtowers and stepped defensive walls.
reconstruction.basis: Original geometry from attributed current OSM and castle-operator exterior/courtyard/aerial photographs. Numerical Terrarium terrain samples determine provisional relative ground levels.
reconstruction.referenceState: Terrain is supplied by the host, not embedded into the runtime architecture. Trees, rocks, gardens,interiors,sculpture,museum collections and inclined railway mechanics are separate or excluded. Gate sections and terrain contacts require real-site review.
